claim_boundary.statement: This admission policy specifies evidence required for later deterministic offline builds. It does not attest that any dependency closure, toolchain, recipe, adapter, build receipt, binary, image, license review, or matched-resource control exists or has passed review.

requirements: Record the detected licenses of every source, transitive dependency, toolchain component, and redistributed runtime artifact.
Bind notices, source-offer obligations, linking obligations, and redistribution terms to immutable digests.
Obtain an independent review verdict before any build is admitted for comparison.
Pin the same physical host, CPU allocation, memory ceiling, wall-clock accounting boundary, instance bytes, repetitions, and result validator for every solver.
Pin per-solver seed semantics, startup and shutdown allowances, timeout signals, filesystem limits, network isolation, and container runtime settings.
Require immutable image digests and a final live provenance replay before claim-grade execution.
Report unsupported or inherently unseeded solvers explicitly rather than claiming seed parity.
Pin a complete offline .NET SDK, runtime, FSharp compiler, GNU Make, and operating-system package closure by digest and byte size.
Pin every transitive NuGet package and restore index used by the solution and all projects.
Record target platform, architecture, locale, timezone, umask, and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.
Prove the closure succeeds with network disabled and no host package cache.
Provide an immutable recipe that verifies source and closure digests before use.
Use network mode none, an empty writable build root, fixed environment values, and no undeclared host mounts.
Build twice from fresh roots and require byte-identical normalized artifacts and image configuration.
Map the complete harness argv to upstream semantics without changing the instance or extending the measured solve allowance.
Write exactly one non-empty requested output file and reject ambiguous fallback outputs.
Propagate exit status and timeout signals, emit no unbounded child process, and perform no network access.
Pass the independent ITC-2019 validator before any result is retained.
Bind the ordered upstreams, recipe hash, adapter hash, pinned base images, exact argv, network_mode none, build_success true, and produced image digest.
Record two successful clean-root build identities and the independent reviewer verdict.
Bind every executable, runtime file, adapter, configuration file, and image layer used at runtime by path, size, and SHA-256.
Replay the produced image digest through competitor provenance immediately before and after matched runs.
Pin a complete offline JDK, Maven, Maven plugin, operating-system package, and runtime closure by digest and byte size.
Pin the extension and required CPSolver core archives in their ordered roles and every transitive Maven artifact and metadata file.
Record target platform, architecture, locale, timezone, umask, and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.
Prove Maven offline mode succeeds from an empty local repository with network disabled.
Provide an immutable recipe that verifies both source archives and the complete dependency closure before use.
Use network mode none, a fresh local Maven repository, fixed environment values, and no undeclared host mounts.
Build twice from fresh roots and require byte-identical normalized JAR contents and image configuration.
Generate the pinned solver configuration deterministically and map the complete harness argv to upstream timeout and seed semantics.
Write exactly one non-empty requested output file and reject ambiguous recursive solution candidates.
Keep one active solver thread, enforce the matched memory limit, propagate failures, and perform no network access.
Pass the independent ITC-2019 validator before any result is retained.
Bind both ordered upstreams, recipe hash, adapter hash, pinned base images, exact argv, network_mode none, build_success true, and produced image digest.
Record two successful clean-root build identities and the independent reviewer verdict.
Bind the solver JAR, core classes, runtime JARs, JDK, adapter, configuration, and image layers by path, size, and SHA-256.
Replay the produced image digest through multi-upstream competitor provenance immediately before and after matched runs.
Pin a complete offline C and C++ compiler, linker, GNU Make, standard-library, locale-data, operating-system package, and runtime closure by digest and byte size.
Pin every transitive header, static library, shared library, generated input, and build helper selected by the reviewed Makefile path.
Record target platform, architecture, locale, timezone, umask, and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH.
Prove the closure succeeds with network disabled and no host compiler or library fallback.
Provide an immutable recipe that verifies source and closure digests before use.
Use network mode none, an empty writable build root, fixed compiler flags and environment values, and no undeclared host mounts.
Build twice from fresh roots and require byte-identical normalized binaries, locale data, and image configuration.
Map the complete unseeded harness argv to the pinned upstream algorithm and CPU-limit semantics without implying seed parity.
Force the reviewed locale, write exactly one non-empty requested output file, and reject ambiguous fallback outputs.
Pin one CPU, propagate hard timeout and exit status, emit no unbounded child process, and perform no network access.
Pass the independent ITC-2019 validator before any result is retained.
Bind the ordered upstream, recipe hash, adapter hash, pinned base images, exact argv, network_mode none, build_success true, and produced image digest.
Record two successful clean-root build identities and the independent reviewer verdict.
Bind the solver binary, dynamic libraries, locale tree, adapter, configuration, and image layers by path, size, and SHA-256.
Replay the produced image digest through competitor provenance immediately before and after matched runs.
